dogecoin.text:
Early adoption came from online forums like Reddit, where Dogecoin found a home. Its fun, lighthearted nature attracted users tired of Bitcoin’s seriousness

Other meme-inspired tokens emerged, riding the wave of community-driven hype and the increasing influence of internet

Memecoins started with Dogecoin in 2013—a joke coin created by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer to mock crypto speculation. 

No one expected it to last, yet it built a community that tipped creators, funded charities, and even sent the Jamaican bobsled team to the Olympics. https://t.co/19tUscxVAU
